Leo · Listen & Shadow 21

The Friday Report — reporting back, rebuilding trust
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
SCENE 1 · THE WEEK
👤 Friend
Did you play any soccer this week?
이번 주 축구는 했어?
play — (운동을) 하다
💬 Leo
Not yet — I haven't played in the new shoes yet.
아직. 새 축구화 신고는 아직 못 뛰어봤어.
not yet — 아직 안 했다 · yet — 아직
같은 패턴으로 — Not yet — I haven't opened it yet. · I haven't tried the new racket yet.
💬 Leo
I'll try not to work this week.
이번 주는 일 안 하려고 해봐야지.
try not to ~ — ~하지 않으려고 하다 (I will not try to work는 '일하려는 시도를 안 하겠다'가 되어 뜻이 달라짐)
같은 패턴으로 — I'll try not to check email tonight. · I'll try not to be late again.
👤 Friend
How are the new things treating you?
새로 산 것들은 어때?
treat — 대하다, (물건이) ~하게 느껴지다
💬 Leo
I'm very satisfied with the MX Master mouse.
MX 마스터 마우스는 아주 만족해.
satisfied with ~ — ~에 만족한
같은 패턴으로 — I'm very satisfied with the chair. · She's satisfied with the result.
💬 Leo
It felt like an unnecessary purchase, but it increased my work efficiency.
불필요한 소비였나 싶었는데, 업무 효율이 올라가더라.
unnecessary — 불필요한 · purchase — 구매 · efficiency — 효율
같은 패턴으로 — It felt like an unnecessary trip, but it cleared my head. · The extra monitor increased my efficiency.
👤 Friend
Can I leave that one to you?
그 일 너한테 맡겨도 돼?
leave ~ to someone — ~를 맡기다
💬 Leo
You can count on me.
나만 믿어.
count on ~ — ~를 믿고 맡기다
같은 패턴으로 — You can count on her. · You can count on me for the numbers.
💬 Leo
I'm confident. I'm ready.
자신 있어. 준비됐고.
confident — 자신 있는
같은 패턴으로 — I'm confident about the schedule. · I'm ready whenever you are.
SCENE 2 · THE PLAN
👤 Friend
When would you go to Iceland?
아이슬란드는 언제 갈 생각이야?
would — ~할 것 같다 (가정)
💬 Leo
I'm not certain, but the best window is September and October.
확실하진 않은데, 최적 시기는 9월이랑 10월이야.
certain — 확실한 · window — (적기가 되는) 기간
같은 패턴으로 — The best window is early spring. · I'm not certain, but I'd say Friday.
💬 Leo
I want to see the icebergs and the northern lights.
빙산이랑 오로라를 보고 싶어.
iceberg — 빙산 · northern lights — 오로라
💬 Leo
I'd give at least two weeks to the trip.
최소 2주는 잡고 싶어.
at least — 최소한 · give ~ to ~ — ~에 ~를 할애하다
같은 패턴으로 — I'd give at least three days to Tokyo. · I'd give an hour to the gym.
💬 Leo
I'd fly into Helsinki and out of Helsinki.
헬싱키로 들어갔다가 헬싱키로 나올 거야.
fly into ~ — ~로 (비행기로) 들어가다 · fly out of ~ — ~에서 나오다
같은 패턴으로 — I'd fly into Rome and out of Milan. · We flew into Jeju and out of Busan.
SCENE 3 · THE BUDGET
👤 Friend
What would the whole trip run you?
돈은 얼마나 들 것 같아?
run someone — (비용이) ~에게 들다
💬 Leo
Flights run in the three-million-won range.
항공권은 300만 원대야.
in the ~ range — ~대(가격대)
같은 패턴으로 — Hotels run in the 200,000-won range. · Good ones are in the one-million-won range.
💬 Leo
I'd budget around five million won for the whole trip.
전체는 500만 원쯤 잡을 거야.
budget — 예산을 잡다 · whole — 전체의
같은 패턴으로 — I'd budget around 100,000 won for dinner. · Budget around two hours for the drive.
💬 Leo
It's a tough call.
쉽지 않은 결정이야.
tough call — 판단하기 어려운 결정
같은 패턴으로 — That's a tough call. · Choosing between them was a tough call.
SCENE 4 · WHICH ONE FIRST
👤 Friend
Iceland or Palau — which one first?
아이슬란드랑 팔라우 중에 어디 먼저?
which one — 어느 쪽
💬 Leo
I want to go to Palau first.
팔라우를 먼저 가고 싶어.
first — 먼저
같은 패턴으로 — I want to try the ramen place first. · Let's do the hard part first.
💬 Leo
The fun in Palau is watching the sea animals.
팔라우의 재미는 바다 생물을 보는 거니까.
sea animal — 바다 생물
같은 패턴으로 — The fun in Kyoto is walking the old streets. · The fun of camping is the fire.
💬 Leo
I wonder about the Garden of God.
'신의 정원'이라는 데가 궁금해.
wonder about ~ — ~가 궁금하다
같은 패턴으로 — I wonder about the price. · I wonder about how they built it.
💬 Leo
Palau is worth the trip.
팔라우는 멀어도 갈 만해.
worth ~ — ~할 가치가 있다 (worth the travel보다 worth the trip이 자연스러움)
같은 패턴으로 — That museum is worth the trip. · The view is worth the climb.
느리게 23/23 · 보통 23/23
